sources.claim: Cloudflare describes NotPetya as malware that had many similarities to Petya but behaved differently.
MITRE ATT&CK lists GoldenEye and Petrwrap among NotPetya associated software names and classifies NotPetya as destructive wiper-like malware.

curator_note: Tentative because the relationship is similarity/variant-family context, while the behavior materially diverges into destructive wiper behavior.
confidence_reason: The relation is historically common and source-supported, but the exact lineage should stay cautious until backed by deeper reverse-engineering citations.
